table.name: attendance
table.purpose: Junction/association table recording which member attended which event (e.g., a student organization's event attendance log). Each row is one member-event attendance record.

link_to_event.name: event_id
link_to_event.description: Reference to event.event_id, identifying the event the member attended. Airtable-style record ID (rec...).

link_to_member.name: member_id
link_to_member.description: Reference to member.member_id, identifying the member who attended the event. Airtable-style record ID (rec...).

table.name: budget
table.purpose: Per-event budget line items for a club/organization: each row allocates a dollar amount to a spending category (Food, Advertisement, Parking, etc.) for a specific event, tracking how much has been spent and what remains. Expenses in the expense table are charged against these budget lines.

amount.name: budgeted_amount
amount.description: Dollar amount allocated for this budget line (whole dollars, 10-350).

budget_id.name: budget_id
budget_id.description: Primary key (Airtable-style record id) uniquely identifying each budget line; referenced by expense.link_to_budget.

category.name: spending_category
category.description: Type of planned expense: Food, Advertisement, Parking, Speaker Gifts, Club T-Shirts.

event_status.name: event_status
event_status.description: Status of the associated event: Open, Closed, or Planning. Likely a denormalized copy of the event's status.

link_to_event.name: event_id
link_to_event.description: Foreign key to event.event_id; the event this budget line belongs to.

remaining.name: remaining_amount
remaining.description: Dollars left in this budget line (amount minus spent); can go negative when spending exceeded the allocation.

spent.name: spent_amount
spent.description: Dollars spent against this budget line so far (0.0 for untouched lines).

table.name: event
table.purpose: Schedule of organization (likely a student club) events: meetings, guest speakers, games, community service, socials, elections and budget reviews, with date, location, status and notes. Referenced by attendance and budget tables.

event_date.name: event_date
event_date.description: Date and time the event takes place (stored as text, ISO datetime). Range spans Sep 2019 - May 2020, i.e. an academic year.

event_id.name: event_id
event_id.description: Primary key, Airtable-style record id ('rec' + 14 chars). Referenced by attendance.link_to_event and budget.link_to_event.

event_name.name: event_name
event_name.description: Human-readable event title (e.g. 'Officers meeting - March', 'Habitat for Humanity').

location.name: location
location.description: Where the event is held: campus room ('MU 215'), campus stadiums, or street addresses; sometimes 'Various locations' or null.

notes.name: notes
notes.description: Free-text description/eligibility notes, e.g. volunteer opportunity details, attendance rules, who may attend.

type.name: type
type.description: Event category: Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Community Service, Social, Election, Budget, and one more (8 distinct).

table.name: expense
table.purpose: Expense records for a student club/organization: each row is a single approved expense (cost, date, description), linked to a budget category and the member who incurred or submitted it. Dates fall in Aug–Nov 2019, suggesting a semester of club activities (meetings, events with food, posters, shirts).

approved.name: approved
approved.description: Whether the expense was approved. Stored as text 'true'/'false'; all non-null values are 'true' (31 of 32 rows, one null).

cost.name: cost
cost.description: Monetary amount of the expense in dollars (range 6.00–295.12, mean ~65.19).

expense_date.name: expense_date
expense_date.description: Date the expense was incurred/paid, between 2019-08-20 and 2019-11-19.

expense_description.name: expense_description
expense_description.description: Free-text description of what was purchased (e.g., Pizza, Posters, Club shirts, Parking, snacks like water/chips/cookies).

expense_id.name: expense_id
expense_id.description: Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for the expense row.

link_to_budget.name: link_to_budget
link_to_budget.description: Foreign key to budget.budget_id, assigning the expense to a budget category (e.g., Advertisement, Food, Parking). Many expenses to one budget line.

link_to_member.name: link_to_member
link_to_member.description: Foreign key to member.member_id, the member who submitted/incurred the expense; only 3 distinct members account for all 32 expenses.

table.name: income
table.purpose: Records of money received by a student organization (likely a club): membership dues plus occasional fundraising, sponsorship, and school funding, each row linked to the member who paid or secured it. Complements the 'expense' and 'budget' tables. Amounts appear to be in whole dollars (likely cents if stored as BIGINT, but values like 50 suggest dollars).

amount.name: amount
amount.description: Monetary amount received, in dollars. Mostly $50 membership dues; one-off larger amounts ($200, $1000, $3000) correspond to fundraising, sponsorship, and school funding entries.

date_received.name: date_received
date_received.description: Date the money was received (stored as text, ISO date format). All entries fall in Sep–Oct 2019, consistent with a semester of dues collection.

income_id.name: income_id
income_id.description: Primary key; unique Airtable-style record ID ('rec...') for each income entry.

link_to_member.name: link_to_member
link_to_member.description: Reference to member.member_id — the member who paid the dues or secured the income. Nullable (some income, e.g. school funding, is not tied to a member).

notes.name: notes
notes.description: Optional free-text note describing the income; present only on the three non-dues entries (ad revenue, Student Government funding, donations for speaker gifts).

source.name: source
source.description: Category of income: 'Dues' (33 rows), plus one each of 'Fundraising', 'Sponsorship', and 'School Appropration' (sic — likely 'School Appropriation').

table.name: major
table.purpose: A lookup/reference table of academic majors (one row per major) at what appears to be a university (values suggest Utah State University's college/department structure). Each major is assigned to a college and a department, and members reference their major via major_id.

college.name: college
college.description: The name of the college the major belongs to (e.g., College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences, College of Humanities and Social Sciences). 8 distinct colleges.

department.name: department
department.description: The name of the academic department or school administering the major (e.g., Applied Economics Department, School of Accountancy). 47 distinct departments.

major_id.name: major_id
major_id.description: Primary key; unique Airtable-style record ID (prefixed 'rec') identifying each major. Referenced by member.link_to_major, so each member's major points to a row here.

major_name.name: major_name
major_name.description: The human-readable name of the academic major/degree program (e.g., Accounting, History, Environmental Engineering). Unique per row.

table.name: member
table.purpose: Roster of members of a student organization (likely at LPU, given .edu emails), with contact info, officer position, major, t-shirt size, and home ZIP code. Referenced by attendance, expense, and income records. IDs are Airtable-style record IDs (rec...).

email.name: email
email.description: Member's email address, firstname.lastname@lpu.edu format; unique per member.

link_to_major.name: major_id
link_to_major.description: Reference to the member's academic major in the major lookup table (Airtable record ID). Nullable — some members have no declared major.

member_id.name: member_id
member_id.description: Primary key; Airtable-style record ID uniquely identifying each member. Referenced by attendance, expense, and income tables.

phone.name: phone
phone.description: Member's phone number; mixed formats (some (XXX) XXX-XXXX, many XXX-555-XXXX, i.e., fictional 555 numbers).

position.name: position
position.description: Member's standing/role in the organization: Member, Inactive, or an officer role (President, Secretary, Treasurer; a 6th distinct value exists but is not shown).

t_shirt_size.name: t_shirt_size
t_shirt_size.description: Member's t-shirt size: Small, Medium, Large, or X-Large.

zip.name: zip_code
zip.description: Member's home ZIP code (US postal code), referencing the zip_code lookup table. Note some values appear zero-truncated (e.g., 1020, 8021 likely 01020/08021) since stored as integer.

table.name: zip_code
table.purpose: US postal ZIP code reference table: one row per ZIP code with its city, county, state (full and abbreviated) and USPS ZIP type. Used as a lookup referenced by member.zip in this database.

city.name: city
city.description: Primary city or town name served by the ZIP code (USPS preferred place name).

county.name: county
county.description: County (or county-equivalent such as borough, municipio, or census area) containing the ZIP code.

short_state.name: short_state
short_state.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation (includes territories, e.g. PR).

state.name: state
state.description: Full state or territory name corresponding to short_state.

type.name: zip_type
type.description: USPS ZIP code classification: Standard (general delivery area), PO Box (post-office-box-only ZIP), Unique (single high-volume address such as a company or building).

zip_code.name: zip_code
zip_code.description: US postal ZIP code (5-digit), primary key of the table; referenced by member.zip.
